name: Kra'gh the Dreugh King

abilities.name: Entrance
abilities.description: When Kra'gh the Dreugh King appears, it busts through a rock wall. Any player too close will get knocked back.

abilities.name: Jagged Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Lunging Strike
abilities.description: A heavy melee attack that does high physical damage and knocks the target back. This can be blocked to stagger Kra'gh the Dreugh King instead.

abilities.name: Storm Flurry
abilities.description: Kra'gh the Dreugh King channels a series of swipes at a target in front of it, dealing moderate shock damage over time.

abilities.name: Lightning Tow
abilities.description: Kra'gh the Dreugh King pulls a target that is far away toward himself.

abilities.name: Lightning Field
abilities.description: Kra'gh the Dreugh King summons a large storm around himself, dealing very high shock damage as indicated by a red circle. Blocking doesn't reduce damage taken.

abilities.name: Summon Mudcrabs
abilities.description: At 66% and 36% health, the boss will run to a fixed location in the arena to summon a few weak mudcrabs to attack the party. These should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

related_quests: Kings of the Grotto: Clear out an old grotto for a group of Mephala worshipers.
Pledge: Fungal Grotto I: Explore Fungal Grotto I and return Undaunted.
Fungal Grotto Pledge: Explore Fungal Grotto and return Undaunted. (disabled since Patch 2.6.4)
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Kra'gh. Kra'gh the Dreugh King is a dreugh and the final boss of Fungal Grotto I. It is the namesake of the Kra'gh set and the basis of a trophy, bust, and outfit style.
